attractions.name: Edakkal Caves
attractions.description: Caves in the Ambukuthi hills known for ancient rock engravings, carvings and symbols associated with prehistoric life.
tips: The visit involves an uphill walk.
Wear broken-in walking shoes with good grip.
attractions._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Apoorva_Wayanad_All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Jungle Treasures Ayurvedic Spice Garden
attractions.description: Recommended spice garden for exploring Wayanad's spice-growing heritage, including pepper, cardamom, cinnamon and cloves.
attractions._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Apoorva_Wayanad_All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Kuruva Island
attractions.description: Cluster of river islands on the Kabini River with dense greenery, bamboo groves and a riverside ecosystem.
tips: Wear secure walking shoes for island paths.
attractions._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Apoorva_Wayanad_All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Wayanad Wildlife Sanctuary
attractions.description: Forest safari destination in the Muthanga range with opportunities to spot elephants, deer, wild boars and birds.
tips: Carry safari confirmations and required entry documents.
attractions._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Apoorva_Wayanad_All Inclusive Guide.docx

local_dishes.description: Steamed rice flour and coconut cakes served with black chickpea curry.

local_dishes.name: Kerala Sadya
